issue.title: Upgrade athena chezmoi from v2.13.1, then move cron: data to home/.chezmoidata/cron.yaml

task_type_fields.proposal:
Upgrade athena's chezmoi from v2.13.1 (`~/.nix-profile/bin/chezmoi`, built by nixpkgs). It
is the oldest chezmoi in the fleet: apollo runs v2.70.2 and the Mac v2.52.1. Then simplify
the crontab layer that v2.13.1 constrained:

- Move the `cron:` data from `home/.chezmoidata.yaml` into `home/.chezmoidata/cron.yaml`.
  v2.13.1 supports only the single root data file.
- Optionally refactor the `.chezmoitemplates/cron-*` partials to use `includeTemplate`.
  v2.13.1 lacks it, which forced every partial to render a whole output.

Keep `tests/bash/cron_render_test.sh`, `cron_sync_test.sh`, `cronctl_offline_test.sh`, and
`cronctl_test.sh` green, along with the byte-identical render check across the remaining
fleet versions. Update the docs that name the data path: the `/crontab` skill and its
generated copies, the crontab memory note, the chezmoi README `## Crontabs`, the cron
block's BEGIN marker text, and bob-cli `docs/vault-git-sync.md`. Changing the marker text is
safe: markers match on the `# BEGIN chezmoi-cron` prefix.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The bob-cli-ib epic had to support athena's v2.13.1 as installed. Upgrading a nix-managed
binary on athena and restructuring the data are separate changes, and the epic plan listed
them as an explicit follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ib.6 proposed this follow-up as the epic plan required. v2.13.1 is the fleet floor that forced the single-file cron: data and whole-output partials.

payload.description: both edit the cron: data in home/.chezmoidata.yaml; land the retire deletion before or with the data move
